title: Siman 291
section: The Virtue of Those Who Drew Close to Him

segments.he: סִפֵּררַבִּי נַפְתָּלִי שֶׁאָמַר רַבֵּנוּ זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה, שֶׁטּוֹב
segments.en: (1.) He said to Rabbi Yudl and Rabbi Shmuel Aizik of blessed memory when they were traveling to him from Dashiv to Medvedivkeh — and once they wanted to move to the surroundings of Medvedivkeh in order to always be close to him — and so they did. Then he said that he is very longing after the roads they traveled to him. And he said that with every step they took when they traveled to him, an angel was created from each and every step. And they said to him: "But we also have much exertion and many steps we walk before we hire the wagon to travel." He replied: "Certainly that too is included — for from those steps too an angel is created from every single step."
